source.title: Simply B1 Preliminary for Schools: 8 Complete Practice Tests
source.questions: Original student-book pages supplied by the user.
source.answerKey: WordHop-authored answer key and English explanations based on the supplied recordings; not a publisher key.

parts.title: Part 1
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

questions.prompt: What will the girl bring to the dinner?
questions.explanation: She decides to bake a chocolate cake for dessert. The family is already serving chicken and tells her she need not bring drinks.
questions.evidence: Maybe I’ll make a chocolate cake.
questions.explanationVi: Cô gái quyết định làm bánh sô-cô-la để tráng miệng. Gia đình đã có món gà và bảo cô không cần mang đồ uống.

questions.prompt: Where is the girl hurting now?

optionText.A: Her leg (arrow pointing to her lower leg).
optionText.B: Her arm (arrow pointing to her upper arm).
optionText.C: Her head (arrow pointing to her head).

questions.explanation: Her leg is sore because the bicycle landed on it. The hand only has a small cut, and she did not hit her head.
questions.evidence: The bike landed on my leg though and now it’s very sore.
questions.explanationVi: Chân cô gái đang đau vì chiếc xe đạp đổ đè lên đó. Tay cô chỉ bị xước nhẹ và đầu không bị va đập.

questions.prompt: Where was the dog found?

optionText.A: In a park with benches and a lamp post.
optionText.B: Outside the front door of a house.

questions.explanation: The butcher found the dog looking through his shop window at sausages and kept her for Bill. The park is where she ran away.
questions.evidence: I got a phone call from the butcher to say she was looking through his window at the sausages.
questions.explanationVi: Người bán thịt tìm thấy con chó đang nhìn xúc xích qua cửa kính cửa hàng và giữ nó lại cho Bill. Công viên là nơi nó bỏ chạy trước đó.

questions.prompt: What programme does the girl want to watch on TV today?

optionText.B: A programme showing an airline pilot.

questions.explanation: She wants to watch the special report about pilots. She finds watching volleyball boring and is willing to miss the music show.
questions.evidence: There’s a special report on pilots.
questions.explanationVi: Cô gái muốn xem phóng sự đặc biệt về phi công. Cô thấy xem bóng chuyền khá chán và sẵn sàng bỏ qua chương trình ca nhạc.

questions.prompt: Which DVD did the boy like most?

optionText.A: A DVD with two singers performing on its label.
optionText.B: A DVD with a racing car on its label.
optionText.C: A DVD with basketball players on its label.

questions.explanation: The singing picture represents the karaoke DVD, which he enjoyed most. Car racing and basketball are the other DVDs he received.
questions.evidence: I enjoyed having a good sing more than anything.
questions.explanationVi: Hình các ca sĩ tượng trưng cho đĩa karaoke, loại đĩa cậu thích nhất vì được hát. Đua xe và bóng rổ là nội dung của hai đĩa khác cậu nhận được.

questions.prompt: Which sport did the girl do for the first time last summer?
questions.explanation: She tried surfing after getting advice from the instructor. Swimming and water skiing were activities she was already doing.
questions.evidence: I had a chat with the surfboarding instructor and he told me how to do it safely.
questions.explanationVi: Cô gái thử lướt sóng sau khi được người hướng dẫn chỉ cách chơi an toàn. Bơi và trượt nước là những môn cô đã chơi từ trước.

questions.prompt: What can you buy half price today?
questions.explanation: All novels at Books Galore have a 50% discount, so books are half price. Fruit and meat are mentioned without that offer.
questions.evidence: Books Galore has 50% off all novels today.
questions.explanationVi: Books Galore giảm giá 50% cho tất cả tiểu thuyết, tức là sách còn nửa giá. Trái cây và thịt không có ưu đãi này.

parts.title: Part 2
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about a family visit to a cafe.

What did the girl’s mother like best?

optionText.B: the pictures hanging on the walls
optionText.C: the cake along with her drink

questions.explanation: The mother particularly enjoyed the cake and had a second piece. The apple juice and the pictures are discussed by other members of the group.
questions.evidence: The cake was fantastic. It was really delicious.
questions.explanationVi: Mẹ cô gái thích bánh nhất và ăn thêm miếng thứ hai. Nước ép táo và các bức tranh là những điều các thành viên khác trong nhóm nhắc đến.

questions.prompt:
You will hear a boy talking about his big brother learning to drive.

How did the boy’s brother feel about his first lesson?

optionText.A: quite nervous as he was afraid of crashing
optionText.B: excited to have the chance to get around on his own
optionText.C: bored as he already knew how to drive

questions.explanation: He is excited about the freedom to travel without relying on his parents. His brother explicitly says he was too excited to worry about crashing.
questions.evidence: He was too excited to be worried. In fact, it was great fun.
questions.explanationVi: Anh trai cậu rất hào hứng vì sắp có thể tự đi lại mà không cần bố mẹ đưa đón. Anh quá háo hức nên không lo đâm xe.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about getting a Saturday job.

The girl thinks that

optionText.A: it’s a good idea to look for a job.
optionText.B: they would both be too tired.
optionText.C: they should take any job they can get.

questions.explanation: She agrees that they should find jobs and suggests looking online. Her concern about tiredness means they should choose suitable work, not abandon the idea.
questions.evidence: Good idea. We can look online to find a job.
questions.explanationVi: Cô gái đồng ý tìm việc và đề nghị tìm trên mạng. Việc lo bị mệt chỉ có nghĩa là họ cần chọn công việc phù hợp.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about a film they have seen.

What do they agree on?

optionText.A: The film was better than they had expected.
optionText.C: There should have been less action.

questions.explanation: Both think the characters behave unrealistically. One speaker enjoyed the action, so they do not agree that there should have been less of it.
questions.evidence: The characters were not very realistic. ... Yes, I have to agree with you there.
questions.explanationVi: Cả hai đều thấy cách hành xử của nhân vật thiếu thực tế. Một người thích các cảnh hành động, nên họ không cùng cho rằng phim cần ít hành động hơn.

questions.prompt:
You will hear a boy telling his friend about a school trip to a museum.

How did he feel about it?

optionText.A: He would be willing to visit it again soon.
optionText.B: He thought it was a waste of time.
optionText.C: It was more interesting than he had expected.

questions.explanation: He was reluctant to go but was surprised by how much he enjoyed the museum. He says he would not want to visit again.
questions.evidence: Well, surprisingly, I had a great time.
questions.explanationVi: Ban đầu cậu không muốn đi, nhưng lại bất ngờ thấy chuyến tham quan bảo tàng rất thú vị. Dù vậy, cậu nói mình không muốn quay lại.

questions.prompt:
You will hear two friends talking about a new teacher.

They think the new teacher is

optionText.A: more interesting than the rest of the teachers.
optionText.B: funny and never gives them any homework.

questions.explanation: They say she brings lessons to life and is different from their other teachers. She gives little homework, but they do not say she never gives any.
questions.evidence: She really brings the lessons to life. She’s not like the other teachers.
questions.explanationVi: Họ thấy cô giáo làm bài học sinh động hơn và khác với các giáo viên còn lại. Cô giao ít bài tập, chứ họ không nói cô hoàn toàn không giao bài.

parts.title: Part 3
parts.instructions: For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one or two words or a number or a date or a time.
parts.heading: Flying High
parts.context: You will hear a student called Andreana giving a presentation to her class about her father’s job.

questions.prompt: Andreana’s project is about ________.
questions.explanation: She chose the project topic about jobs rather than the environment. The plural “jobs” matches the topic she names.
questions.evidence: I chose the first project which focuses on jobs.
questions.explanationVi: Cô chọn đề tài về việc làm, thay vì môi trường. Từ số nhiều “jobs” đúng với tên chủ đề cô nhắc đến.

questions.prompt: After university, her father worked as a teacher in a ________.
questions.explanation: Before becoming a pilot, her father taught in a primary school. Both words belong in the gap after “a”.
questions.evidence: He taught in a primary school and he really enjoyed it.
questions.explanationVi: Trước khi làm phi công, bố cô từng dạy ở trường tiểu học. Chỗ trống sau “a” cần cả hai từ “primary school”.

questions.prompt: On his first flight ________ passengers were travelling to Italy on his plane.
questions.explanation: There were 80 holidaymakers travelling as passengers. The additional six people were working on the plane.
questions.evidence: A plane with 80 happy holiday makers on their way to Italy.
questions.explanationVi: Có 80 hành khách đang đi nghỉ trên chuyến bay. Sáu người còn lại là những người làm việc trên máy bay.

questions.prompt: Difficult passengers and bad ________ are problems that a pilot has to deal with.
questions.explanation: Bad weather and difficult passengers are the two unexpected problems mentioned. The gap follows the adjective “bad”.
questions.evidence: Unexpected things happen during a flight, such as bad weather or difficult passengers.
questions.explanationVi: Thời tiết xấu và hành khách khó tính là hai vấn đề bất ngờ được nhắc đến. Từ “weather” đứng sau tính từ “bad” để nói về thời tiết xấu.

questions.prompt: Andreana’s father says that some plane travellers feel that they lose ________ of their life when flying.
questions.explanation: Nervous travellers want control of their lives and feel they must give it up on a plane. “Control” completes “lose ___ of their life”.
questions.evidence: They need to be in control of their life, and when they get on a plane, they have to give up that control.
questions.explanationVi: Một số hành khách hay lo lắng muốn tự kiểm soát cuộc sống và cảm thấy mất điều đó khi đi máy bay. “Control” hoàn thành cụm “lose control of their life”.

questions.prompt: She says that he drinks a cup of ________ just after his plane has taken off.
questions.explanation: He has coffee after take-off to help him stay awake and ready for problems. “Coffee” completes “a cup of ___”.
questions.evidence: He always has a coffee to make him feel extra awake and ready for anything.
questions.explanationVi: Bố cô uống cà phê sau khi máy bay cất cánh để tỉnh táo và sẵn sàng xử lý vấn đề. “Coffee” hoàn thành cụm “a cup of coffee”.

parts.title: Part 4
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.
parts.context: You will hear an interview with a young writer called Darren.

questions.prompt: When did Darren first start to write stories?

optionText.A: after reading a lot while he was a child
optionText.B: when he was recovering from an illness

questions.explanation: He began writing after leaving hospital, while recovering at home in bed. He says he had not previously been much of a reader.
questions.evidence: When I was allowed home, I had several months in bed ... I was very bored and just started to write.
questions.explanationVi: Darren bắt đầu viết sau khi ra viện, trong lúc nằm dưỡng bệnh ở nhà. Trước đó, anh không phải người đọc nhiều sách.

questions.prompt: Writing helped Darren to

optionText.B: talk more to his friends and family.
optionText.C: become one of the happiest teenagers.

questions.explanation: The book eventually earned money for Darren and his family. He does not say writing made him talk more or become one of the happiest teenagers.
questions.evidence: The book would become something that helped me and my family earn money.
questions.explanationVi: Cuốn sách cuối cùng đã giúp Darren và gia đình kiếm tiền. Anh không nói việc viết sách khiến mình nói chuyện nhiều hơn hay trở thành một thiếu niên rất hạnh phúc.

questions.prompt: Why didn’t Darren send his book to a publisher?

optionText.A: He wanted to write a second book first.
optionText.B: He wanted to finish his therapy first.
optionText.C: He didn’t think it was good enough.

questions.explanation: He did not believe his writing was good and never intended anyone to read it. He was not waiting to finish therapy or a second book.
questions.evidence: I never for a second thought the book was any good.
questions.explanationVi: Darren không nghĩ cuốn sách đủ hay và chưa từng định cho người khác đọc. Anh không phải đang chờ kết thúc điều trị hay viết xong cuốn thứ hai.

questions.prompt: Darren’s family read his book because

optionText.A: they were anxious about his feelings.
optionText.B: they always liked the stories he writes in his diary.
optionText.C: they wanted his sister to make a copy of it.

questions.explanation: His family were worried about his feelings and thought they were reading a diary. His sister sent the manuscript to publishers later.
questions.evidence: They were very worried about me and thought I was writing a diary about my feelings.
questions.explanationVi: Gia đình lo lắng về cảm xúc của Darren và tưởng anh đang viết nhật ký. Sau đó, chị/em gái anh mới gửi bản thảo tới các nhà xuất bản.

questions.prompt: How did Darren feel when the publisher emailed him?

optionText.A: He was excited about the opportunity he was offered.
optionText.B: He thought it was a joke.
optionText.C: He was angry at his parents for going behind his back.

questions.explanation: He initially assumed that a friend was playing a joke. He only believed the offer when the publisher’s letter arrived.
questions.evidence: I just thought it was a friend being silly and having some fun.
questions.explanationVi: Lúc đầu Darren nghĩ một người bạn đang đùa mình. Anh chỉ tin lời đề nghị khi nhận được thư của nhà xuất bản.

questions.prompt: What does Darren plan to do next?
questions.explanation: His immediate aim is to finish his exams and study literature after school, which corresponds to university. Writing more books is only a possibility for later.
questions.evidence: I want to study literature after school. Then I might write another book.
questions.explanationVi: Trước mắt Darren muốn thi xong rồi học văn ở đại học. Viết thêm sách chỉ là khả năng anh cân nhắc sau đó.
